memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports mild shortness of breath on exertion, manages shop independently, walks about 1.5 km daily.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (normal).
falls: no falls in last 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 10 seconds (normal).
medicines: 6 regular (orlistat, clobetasol, calcipotriol, methotrexate, folic acid, methylcobalamin). polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria advised.
mood: denies low mood or anxiety; sleep adequate.
carers: mother (Mrs Lakshmi Kulkarni) – primary support.
goal: "I want to reduce my weight and control my skin plaques so I can work longer hours without fatigue."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
orlistat 120 mg PO tID with meals
clobetasol 0.05% cream apply BD to psoriasis plaques
calcipotriol ointment apply OD to psoriasis plaques
methotrexate 7.5 mg PO once weekly
folic acid 5 mg PO daily
methylcobalamin 1500 mcg PO OD

memories.text:
function: weight 88 kg (down 12 kg from baseline), reports improved stamina, walks 3 km comfortably.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (borderline); plan for full cognitive assessment.
falls: no falls in last 12 months; gait slightly slower; timed up-and-go 11 seconds (raised fall risk) – advise strength exercises and supportive footwear.
medicines: 5 regular (orlistat stopped, clobetasol, calcipotriol, methotrexate, folic acid, methylcobalamin) – actually 5 regular; polypharmacy threshold not met but review still advised.
mood: reports occasional low mood linked to work stress; denies anhedonia.
carers: mother (Mrs Lakshmi Kulkarni) – encourages exercise.
goal: "I want to maintain my weight loss and keep my psoriasis under control long-term."

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve been following the exercise plan and my joint pain is much less. The skin plaques are flatter and less red. I still apply the creams twice daily as advised. My energy levels are good and I feel confident managing the shop.
